heading: Mat construction, through the thickness

title.text:
Mat construction: reactive core encapsulated between two carrier geotextiles
Total 8 mm. Vertical scale hugely exaggerated: this is a one metre square of a tile tens of metres across. The geotextiles are inert diffusive resistances and are credited with no capacity. This construction is established practice and no novelty is claimed for it.

heading: Pb sorbed load through the core, per tile

title.text:
Pb sorbed load through the reactive core, per tile
Height is measured from the base of the mat, so the core occupies 3 to 5 mm; the carrier geotextiles hold no load by construction. SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION - hypothetical hotspot, assumed parameters, not a real site and not field validated.
